mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen monotonically for four consecutive weeks (-17.4 to -8.9) in lockstep with a monotone four-week rise in TRANSIT (-23.3 to -13.4). Continued unwinding of trip-avoidance keeps adding retail footfall, so the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean exceeds the last-28-day mean of -12.3.
failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the 28 days after 2022-05-15 is at or below -12.3 while TRANSIT fails to improve further.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL has decayed from 4.4 to 0.7, meaning the stay-at-home surplus is nearly exhausted. Once the weekly RESIDENTIAL mean crosses below +1.0, released home-time converts mostly into out-of-home discretionary activity, lifting RETAIL_REC over the following weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell 4.4 to 0.7 over four weeks
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL drops below +1.0 and the subsequent 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is not above the preceding 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES jumped from -17.9 to -6.3 and then stalled at -6.6, indicating office return is real but plateauing. A second consecutive week at or above -10 confirms durable office presence, which mechanically feeds lunchtime and after-work retail footfall and lifts RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES weekly mean stays at or above -10.0 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: WORKPLACES holds at or above -10 for two weeks yet the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean falls below the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Commuting recovery is multiplicative rather than additive: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES have both risen, and their joint high level concentrates footfall along the Milan transit corridors where retail-and-recreation sits. The joint condition yields a larger retail gain than either series alone.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT at or above -16.0 and WORKPLACES at or above -7.0 simultaneously
failure_condition: The RETAIL_REC gain in weeks where both thresholds hold is no larger than in weeks where only one of the two holds.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM rose to +12.4 then +9.9, far above its early-May +5.6, signalling an inflation-driven essential-spending share. The household budget shift leaves less discretionary capacity, so retail-and-recreation underperforms its recent upward path and the next-28-day mean is lower.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean at or above +10.0 while RETAIL_REC remains below -5.0
regime_hint: steady state with elevated grocery spend
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds its last-28-day mean while GROCERY_PHARM stays at or above +10.0.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS sits at 50.3 against a 40.3 reading three weeks earlier, consistent with the late-spring outdoor season in Lombardy; the t-1w dip to 12.7 was a weather or bridge-holiday artifact rather than a level shift. Sustained warm-evening outdoor time extends leisure hours and lifts retail-and-recreation, especially food and recreation venues.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rebounded to 50.3 in t-0w after 40.3 in t-3w
failure_condition: PARKS stays below +20 for two consecutive weeks and the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean is still below the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: With Lombardy phasing out COVID capacity and access restrictions, mobility gains are no longer capped by binding limits, so rising TRANSIT and WORKPLACES translate directly into retail-and-recreation visits. The marginal transit recovery passes through to RETAIL_REC within one to two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved every week from -23.3 to -13.4
failure_condition: In the week TRANSIT crosses above -15.0 under restriction lifting, RETAIL_REC fails to rise week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: Normalization needs two simultaneous conditions: RESIDENTIAL near baseline (at or below +1.0) means the home-time surplus is gone, and a week-on-week decline in GROCERY_PHARM from 12.4 to 9.9 means the precautionary restocking spike is fading. When both hold, discretionary retail recovers faster than the standalone trend.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL at or below +1.0 and GROCERY_PHARM declines week-on-week
failure_condition: The joint condition holds yet the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean is not above the last-28-day mean.
